content.text: I've inspected every audit, examination, verification, inspection, and usage-monitoring provision in the document.

input.quote: C. Audits. M&I shall cause a third party review of its data processing center, the Operations Center, and related internal controls to be conducted annually by its independent auditors. M&I shall provide without charge to Customer, upon written request, one copy of the audit report resulting from such review.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no audit, inspection, verification or usage-monitoring right running against us. Every audit/examination provision runs the other way or is regulator-driven and benefits us: § 21.8(C) (p0277) obliges M&I to procure an annual independent third-party review of its own Operations Center and give us the report free of charge; § 21.8(B) (p0276) and § 17.1 (p0243) subject M&I-held records and Customer Data to examination by our own regulators and auditors; § 21.8 (p0274) subjects M&I's performance of the Services to examination by our regulatory agencies. § 21.7(C) (p0273) is only a books-and-records reflection covenant with evidence on request, not a right for M&I to audit our usage, fees or systems. With no vendor audit right in place, there is no burden for the frequency, notice, independent-auditor, cost-allocation or system-access limits to constrain, and M&I has no direct access to our systems for audit purposes. We therefore treat AUDIT as satisfied and propose no redline; searches for "audit", inspection/verification, monitoring, certification and underpayment/shortfall language returned no contrary clause.
